project.name: CardDemo App (Composition Root)
project.description: Composition root of the hexagonal architecture: one main class per JCL EXEC PGM= step from app/jcl/. Wires file-based adapters (default) or optional JDBC adapters into use cases via plain Java constructor injection. Establishes ScopedValue<BatchRunContext> at job entry. Packaged as one shaded jar per executable via maven-shade-plugin per AAP §0.2.1, §0.4.1. NO Spring, NO Docker, NO --enable-preview per AAP §0.1.1 architectural override and §0.6.7, §0.7.4 forbidden-features list. Depends on every sibling module except carddemo-tests; this is the ONLY module that supplies logback-classic at runtime scope.
